hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that integrates with Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into Euler vault deposits and pays output tokens from vault withdrawals, enforcing a bonding curve invariant (CurveLib). Liquidity providers earn yield on deposited assets while providing swap liquidity via a delegatecall-proxy pool instance model.
